text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ooooh! There's so many people~!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's the 'Oaks' for you.
My, oh my~, what a magnificent sight~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Man, Ikuno's become a totally famous Umamusume now!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, who do you think's gonna win this time?
I've got my money on Daiichi Ruby.”

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Ikuno Dictus put up a great performance in the Flora Stakes too,
so what are your thoughts on that?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, but don't you think 2,400m is too long?
Even if she can run it, winning would be tough, right?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: What the heck—!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Easy now. Well, with this many people around,
there's bound to be a few who talk, right?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
B-But! Ikuno is definitely going to win!!
'Cause Ikuno has been practicing long-distance running so, so much for so long!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm! We have to believe in them and cheer them on!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Nnnnnngh~~~~~!!!
Sending all my 'Do your best, Ikuno' mental energpyyyyy~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo too! Neeeeh!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —It's finally time.

"I took thorough measures for today.
I did everything within my power."

"All that was left was to send her off with strength.
Making up my mind, I took a deep breath—"
choice_data_list: I'll be waiting again today. For you to come home.
I'll be waiting again today. For you to come home.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Yes.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I will deliver my best run across these 2,400 meters and definitely return. So—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Please look forward to it. Look forward to my victory.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Well then—
I'm off.

As Ikuno Dictus turned her back and began to walk,
her figure looked remarkably powerful—
(WOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(......Just like at the Oka Sho, the air feels heavy today as well.
However—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...No problem.
I've already experienced this before...—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ……Hm? Is that—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (Ruby-san... seems to be focused.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Still, I wonder...
She seems even more on edge than
when we met at the Flora Stakes—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (...No. That is not what I should be concerned about right now.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Today, all that remains is to see my run through to the end...!!
